about: Unmatched launch-path functions carried in the native tree as their best parked draft (Scout1050 trace table, plans 'draft as-is' (score >= 95) and 'draft, verify'). NON-EXACT: never exact-match credit. score = misses_index best; last_lane_score = the last score a lane reported; draft_found_by: index = misses_index names this draft, search = newest/highest .cpp naming the entry (unconfirmed). The draft text is appended to the compile group of host_source (the neighbouring accepted row's unit), as the exact-tree join does. Each included draft is tracked as native/drafts/<entry>.cpp (header: entry, score, origin lane, NON-EXACT DRAFT); origin = the lane scratch path it was copied from (provenance only, never read by the build); author = the lane or worker that wrote it. Blocked rows carry no file (draft null). native: 'compiles' = the draft passes clang (arm64) inside its host group and is appended; 'blocked: <first error>' = not appended (it needs header declarations or macros from the lane's private overlay, or it repeats neighbouring definitions); raw_seed = the path is a Ghidra seed (seed_ namespace, Ghidra types), not the scored draft, so it does not define the real symbol. host_source null = the draft is its own unit (linked after the initialiser units); adapted = a native adaptation of the scored draft (private headers inlined, non-portable statements replaced, each marked NATIVE in the text). behaviour_verdict (null | 'same' | 'differs' | 'cannot tell'), behaviour_checked_by (worker/lane and delivery, e.g. codex4 r474), behaviour_checked_date (YYYY-MM-DD) and behaviour_checked_head (the main commit the draft was compiled and diffed at) record a behaviour check of the draft against the original (Windows pilot 2026-11-11); null = not checked. A 'differs' verdict's patch is applied to native/drafts/<entry>.cpp. native_fix_rechecks lists codex4 behaviour rechecks of native fixes that are not drafts (fixups and behaviour rows): delivery, subject, fix commit, verdict and its scope.
